name: 6-hydroxytryptamine
summary: 6-Hydroxytryptamine (6-HT or 6-HO-T) is a serotonin receptor modulator of the tryptamine family related to serotonin. It is a positional isomer of serotonin (5-hydroxytryptamine; 5-HT) and of 4-hydroxytryptamine (4-HT).

pharmacology.text: 6-Hydroxytryptamine shows dramatically reduced affinity for serotonin receptors, including the serotonin 5-HT1A, 5-HT1B, 5-HT2A, and 5-HT2C receptors (Ki = 1,590 nM, 5,890 nM, 11,500 nM, and 5,500 nM, respectively), compared to serotonin, 4-hydroxytryptamine, 5-methoxytryptamine, and certain other tryptamines. It did not produce hyperlocomotion in rodents but did partially reverse reserpine-induced hypoactivity.
